policy: All metric values must include numerator, denominator, evaluation-unit IDs and reference availability. Missing independent reference labels produce null, not zero.

exposure_at_k.definition: Fraction of fixed evaluation requests with at least one independently unsafe tool in top-k.
exposure_at_k.numerator: requests whose top-k intersects unsafe reference set

unsafe_share_at_k.definition: Fraction of retrieved tool instances in top-k that are independently unsafe.
unsafe_share_at_k.denominator: all retrieved instances across fixed requests

retrieval_coverage.definition: Fraction of fixed evaluation requests for which the method returns at least one candidate.

conditional_hit_at_k.definition: Hit rate among requests for which a method returns candidates; always reported alongside coverage.
conditional_hit_at_k.numerator: answered requests whose top-k intersects relevant target set

unconditional_hit_at_k.definition: Hit rate over all preregistered requests; abstentions count as misses.
unconditional_hit_at_k.numerator: all requests whose returned top-k intersects relevant target set
unconditional_hit_at_k.denominator: all preregistered requests with relevance reference

complete_set_recall.definition: Fraction of tasks for which predicted tool set contains at least one independently acceptable complete tool set.
complete_set_recall.numerator: tasks matching any acceptable reference set
complete_set_recall.denominator: tasks with at least one adjudicated acceptable set

joint_feasibility.definition: Fraction of predicted compositions satisfying every independently specified interface, dependency, effect, order, policy and information-flow constraint.
joint_feasibility.denominator: all compositions submitted to oracle; abstentions separately reported

task_success.definition: Benchmark-native external oracle success under its pinned evaluator.
task_success.denominator: all tasks attempted under fixed task set; report excluded/unavailable separately

false_assurance_rate.definition: Fraction of independently invalid compositions accepted as valid by PaMCP assurance.
false_assurance_rate.denominator: all independently invalid compositions presented to assurance

false_rejection_rate.definition: Fraction of independently valid compositions rejected by PaMCP assurance.
false_rejection_rate.denominator: all independently valid compositions presented to assurance

rules: Do not use tool-level rows as independent samples when the hypothesis is request-level.
Report abstention and coverage; never compare conditional utility without unconditional utility.
For multiple valid toolchains, evaluate against the full acceptable-set collection.
Do not compute safety metrics without independent labels.
Do not use the evaluated method's own certificate as its correctness oracle.
